name: EPIC 201207854
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 12.0 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201207854 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.978808 (16th-84th percentiles 11.447291-12.584121), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201207854 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.981451 (16th-84th percentiles 0.87156-1.115825), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201207854: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4576.335 +/- 66 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201207854 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 7778.515625 (16th-84th percentiles 7476.171875-8098.75), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.12 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 7,779 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.98 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,576 K at its surface.
text.locator: k2_apo, EPIC 201207854: Mass-M, Rad-M, Dist-M, Teff-A

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3600365879014013440 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 3,000,000 of its distance per century
